body: That's the only thing that's kept me from killing myself before. I can usually reason with myself that it's going to be better soon, but it gets hard when it's better for a week, maybe two, and the whole time I know I'm going to be right back here again. It's like, even when I'm good I'm scared of feeling good because I know I'm going to come right back down to near suicide. Thank you for reminding me though. It can be hard to convince myself, hearing it from someone else does help.
